summary: Phase 1 testing completed for Teams, Voicemail, and AI Assistant features. Fixed critical bug in voicemail stats endpoint. All 23 backend tests passing. Frontend pages (Teams, Voicemail) working correctly.

fixed.issue: Route order conflict - /{voicemail_id} was catching /stats requests. Fixed by moving /stats route before /{voicemail_id}

minor.issue: Unused variables in webhook handler (call_control_id, call_leg_id, call_session_id) - not blocking

issues: Teams and Voicemail pages not accessible from bottom navigation - users must navigate directly to /teams or /voicemail

action_items: Consider adding Teams and Voicemail links to BottomNav or Account page for better discoverability
Consider adding data-testid attributes to frontend components for better testability
critical_code_review_comments: Route order in FastAPI matters - static routes (/stats, /list, /settings) must be defined before dynamic routes (/{id})
Frontend pages are working but missing navigation links from main UI

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Teams page, Voicemail page, Settings modal all working)
